Meerkats are sanctuary and pet animals. They are unlocked at reputation level 3.

Like all other sanctuary animals, players can only have four of them, one of each type.

Contents

  • 1 Appearance

  • 5 Decorations

Appearance

Meerkat have two different appearances: red and brown.

Red
Red cub
Brown
Brown cub

Unlocking meerkats

Unlike other animals, meerkats cannot be bought. Players must unlock them by finding puzzle pieces (which are collected in a log book). 36 pieces are required for each animal.

Once players have obtained a first meerkat, the puzzle for the second meerkat is unlocked. After both adult meerkats have been added to the sanctuary, the puzzle for one of the cubs is unlocked.

Placing meerkats

Players must have a meerkat house to be able to place the animal in the sanctuary. The meerkat house is free and can be obtained from the Shop Shop.

When a second meerkat is added to the sanctuary, an upgraded meerkat house is obtained from the Shop. Upgrading does not cost anything. When the house is big enough to welcome a new animal, it is delivered in a crate, "airlifted" into the sanctuary by balloons.

Feeding meerkat

Meerkats are fed with meat buckets. Once meerkats have eaten eat they roam the sanctuary for ten hours and finally fall asleep. Players can immediately wake them up to receive 25 xp per animal and a chance to get supplies. Meerkats stay asleep otherwise.

Meerkats which have been woken up but are not fed for a long while cannot fall asleep and wander around looking sleepy and tired.

  • Tip: Waking up sanctuary animals one by one instead of using a whistle may increase your chance of getting supplies.

Decorations

Each meerkat unlocks some decorations in the shop as specified below:

Chinese Lantern Flowers (Red)
Savannah Cactus (Red cub)
Grassy Rock (Brown)
Dry Grass (Brown cub)

With each animal players are given the first pair of decorations for free.
